client_id.label: Spotify client ID
client_id.description: Only without a Mac. SETUP.md, way 2: the Client ID of the app you make at Spotify.

client_secret.label: Spotify client secret
client_secret.description: The secret of the same Spotify developer app.

refresh_token.label: Spotify refresh token
refresh_token.description: Only if you already have one. Otherwise leave it empty and use Spotify code.

lyrics.label: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Synced lyrics from lrclib.net (free, no account). Off: title and artist only.

helper_addr.label: Vinyl for Mac address
helper_addr.description: Only if you never plug the bar into your Mac: the address Vinyl for Mac prints when it starts, like 192.168.1.20:8765.

helper_code.label: Vinyl for Mac code
helper_code.description: The six-digit code Vinyl for Mac prints beside its address. Full steps: github.com/windAGH/busybar-apps, folder vinyl, SETUP.md.

spotify_code.label: Spotify code
spotify_code.description: Paste the address your browser shows after you agree at Spotify (SETUP.md, way 2). Used once.

spotify_code2.label: Spotify code, the rest
spotify_code2.description: Only if the first field did not take the whole address: what was left over.

timing.label: Words timing
timing.description: When the lyrics change. Normal: a quarter of a second before the voice. Earlier and Later move it by 0.15 s.

knob.label: Volume knob
knob.description: Which way the knob turns the volume up. Reversed: the other way round.

colour.label: Karaoke colour
colour.description: The line being sung fills with the record's colour from left to right. The words' times are known line by line only, so the colour runs evenly.

start_over.label: Start over
start_over.description: Flip this switch to clear everything this app has kept and see the guide again. Each flip starts over once. Cannot be undone.
